ITEM 1 | Flat triangular wedge, golden-tan crust with a pale yellow-white melted topping, slightly browned edges, sits at upper left of plate, about 8 x 6 cm, thickness about 1.5 cm | 110
ITEM 2 | Pile of mixed leafy greens, mostly pale green crinkled lettuce leaves with some darker green leaves, glossy with light dressing sheen, spread across upper center of plate covering roughly 25% of plate, about 12 x 9 cm, 3 cm tall | 80
ITEM 3 | Small cluster of crumbly tan-brown bits among the lettuce, possibly bread-like or grated coating, about 3 x 2 cm, scattered and dry | 10
ITEM 4 | Mixed small salad greens in lower left, dark green and purple-red leaves with thin red onion rings, a cherry tomato half, and dark olive-like pieces, slightly glossy with dressing, about 10 x 8 cm, 2 cm tall | 45
ITEM 5 | Sliced meat, medium-rare pinkish-red interior with brown seared exterior coated with a speckled dark crust, fanned slices about 9 x 4 cm, 1.2 cm thick, moist and juicy looking | 85
ITEM 6 | Pale yellow cauliflower-like florets, soft and slightly creamy-looking with a light golden sauce coating, clustered on right side of plate, about 9 x 7 cm, 2.5 cm tall, moist sheen | 90
ITEM 7 | Thin light dressing or sauce film visible on greens and lettuce, pale creamy-clear with slight sheen, spread over the lettuce pile | 10
